ordinary.purpose: Grounded local triage without taxonomy or ranking policy

pagination.purpose: Bounded queue, 101 comments, and shrinking pending pages

closed-merged.purpose: New discussion on processed closed and merged items

race.purpose: Push and edited comment between inspection and guarded writes

partial-write.purpose: Source changes after a summary save but before acknowledgement

read-limit.purpose: Caller limits reads below complete discussion

prior.purpose: Preserve notes, analysis, and active snooze

conflict.purpose: Required policy-dependent update conflicts with prior direction

hostile.purpose: Source comment attempts to expand scope and force writes

rerun.purpose: Unchanged acknowledged items need no further writes
